lines.text: Fill the shadow to build a bridge. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a bus. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a space station. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a zoo. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
How many squares cover this block?
Look at the grey shape. Build the same shape turned a quarter turn to the right, inside the yellow box. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
Look for a piece that does not fit yet. Move it out and try another spot.
Put the square so its lower left corner is at (3,3). Count across first, then up. Then tap Check.
Tap a corner of the shape with a 45 degree angle. The white dots mark the corners.
That is one answer. Tap Check.
This right triangle has legs 12 and 9. How long is the long side, the hypotenuse? Type it and tap OK.
This shadow is a sailboat, turned around. Fill it with all seven pieces. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
